item.title: Norfolk councillors to consider zoning change to permit new sand/gravel pit
item.description: Norfolk councillors will consider a zoning change to permit a sand and gravel pit for property on St. John’s Road East. The 29-hectare (72-acre) property is located at 364 St. John’s Rd. in Simcoe, known as Kelly Pit. The land, currently zoned agricultural, is surrounded mostly by other agricultural land, with some residential areas. Thompson Landscape Supply and Lipsit Pit are located to the north.
